entities.summary: Fourth Gospel, the most theological of the four. Opens with the Logos prologue ("In the beginning was the Word"), contains the seven "I AM" sayings, and emphasizes belief, eternal life, and the divine identity of Jesus. Written c. 90–100 CE.
